gaps.explanation: Schedule 74,856 vs statement 966 (schedule above by 73,890). The General Fund combining schedule (p10) prints 'Transfers' by department: General (73,890), Community Building 22,096, Police 3,125, Fire 21,143, Park 28,492; Totals 966. Detail records the department inflows gross: 22,096 + 3,125 + 21,143 + 28,492 = 74,856 (indexes 32-35) and the General department outflow (73,890) (index 31). The governmental funds statement (p5) prints only the General Fund net 966 ('Transfers out' 966, Totals 966), i.e. the 73,890 moved between General Fund departments is netted. 74,856 - 73,890 = 966. Gross vs net presentation of intra-General Fund transfers; no detail fix.

Schedule 3,188,748 vs statement 343,949 (schedule above by 2,844,799). Detail index 69 'Nursing Home revenues' 2,844,799 comes from the Combined Schedule of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Cash Balances - Budget and Actual - All Fund Types (p9, one 'General All-Purpose Fund' column, Total revenues 3,657,497). The nursing home is not a fund in the basic statements: the proprietary funds statement (p8) has only Sewer, Ambulance, Water and Sanitation, Total operating revenues 343,949 (= 79,458 + 46,184 + 174,212 + 44,095). The rest of detail business-type revenue (indexes 47, 54, 59, 60, 66) = 343,949 exactly. 343,949 + 2,844,799 = 3,188,748. The line is marked outside_statement (scope difference: the budget schedule includes an operation the statements exclude); no detail fix.

Schedule 3,278,591 vs statement 405,561 (schedule above by 2,873,030). Detail index 70 'Public buildings - Nursing Home' 2,873,030 comes from the p9 all-fund budget schedule (Total expenditures 3,693,158); the nursing home is not in the basic statements. The other business-type detail lines equal the p8 proprietary statement: operating expenses 259,463 (Sewer 96,967, Ambulance 34,808, Water 92,389, Sanitation 35,299) + nonoperating capital expenses 96,889, principal 34,191, interest 15,018 = 405,561 (= statement, Statement of Activities p2). 405,561 + 2,873,030 = 3,278,591. Scope difference; no detail fix.
